entries.note: Vazquez 2018 resolves (PMID 29298069, epub 2018-01-23); quote verbatim in abstract. NCT01835197 start 2013-05 confirms the proxy year. Review line 'in various in vitro cell systems, abrocitinib inhibited cytokine-induced STAT phosphorylation' supports model_filed.

Quote verbatim in abstract; PMC6046510 full text read: biomarkers were IP-10, hsCRP, neutrophils, reticulocytes, platelets, lymphocyte subsets (NK down), dose-dependent, no ex-vivo pSTAT. readout_tier downstream is right; confidence could rise to medium.

Quote verbatim (review offset 87965). IND 123554 opened 30-OCT-2014 per review; pivotal studies 13MA055 (monkey) and 13MA056 (rat) carry 2013 numbers, so the package predates the IND and the proxy year holds.

Quote verbatim. NOAEL AUC 55,200 vs ~3,500-4,400 ng·h/mL at 200 mg (review PK table), ~13x; ~6x at psoriasis 400 mg/day; margin held. No effective exposure ever stated (rule question). confidence_note's 'hence imported_from' contradicts the null field.

Quote verbatim in abstract. Nonclinical section of the review has no adjuvant/arthritis/in-vivo pharmacology mention, so model_filed false is right. Opening on a cross-indication model is allowed by decision 8.

Trial facts verified (NCT02201524 results 2016-10-05; NCT01782664 2017-08-03; NCT01634087 none, co-primary sPGA). Rat AIA never tested psoriasis, so there is no in-context prediction to match; decision 12 transfers cross-indication evidence for safety only. Untested, or blank the cell.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: decision 8 opens the cell on the rat AIA track, scored by decision 4 (psoriasis primaries matched the stated autoimmune prediction); decision 12's safety-only transfer covers imported trials, not in-context ones. Can a cross_indication efficacy track score same?

entries.note: Quote verbatim in abstract. It is an expectation sentence naming no study (#111 caveat) but is the paper's own stated prediction for the whole-blood selectivity assay; opening entry fine.

Quote verbatim. Nonclinical body (offsets 86k-131k) and appendix 16.4 contain zero platelet, reticulocyte or neutrophil mentions; haematology lines record lymphocyte decreases only. Silence confirmed; platelets are a standard rat/monkey haematology readout.

Quote verbatim in abstract. Peeva 2018 full text also shows reticulocyte falls at 100/200 mg BID and Grade 1 thrombocytopenia (n=9) in volunteers. Contra holds; magnitude 'opposite' mirrors decision 5's definition (rule question).

Quote verbatim (offset 142212). Review's platelet PK/PD dataset includes psoriasis B7451005 ('disease-type (Psoriasis)' is a covariate). Animal silence confirmed as in entry 2; harm measurable in both species; imported_from correct for the AD-pooled statement.

checker_notes: Searched for missed model systems: abrocitinib/PF-04965842 in imiquimod, xenograft or skin-explant psoriasis models (none; only a DNCB atopic-dermatitis mouse study); itacitinib/INCB039110 psoriasis models (none; Covington 2020 covers arthritis, IBD, GvHD); solcitinib/GSK2586184 preclinical pharmacology (none public, vendor IC50s only); ex-vivo/3D human psoriatic skin with JAK1-selective drugs (none; tofacitinib keratinocyte cultures, a JAK1/3 3D-skin study, SAR-20347 JAK1/TYK2 imiquimod work and a pan-JAK psoriatic-skin xenograft abstract are all outside the member list). No press release, SEC filing or EMA document reporting an undisclosed failure was found; all three Phase 2s were positive and none went further. Could not open Vazquez 2018 full text (ACS paywall), so the rat-AIA effective dose/exposure remains unverified. Cosmetic: tile gives area/disease as lowercase 'autoimmune'/'psoriasis', draft capitalises; house-style contexts capitalise and v3 drafts are split (6 'Autoimmune' vs 2 'autoimmune'); lint passes either way.
rule_questions: Cross-indication efficacy track: decision 8 opens a cell on the filed cross-indication model, the drafter brief says a class that went to patients on another indication's data leaves the cell empty, and decision 12 lets cross-indication evidence transfer for safety only. Can a cross_indication efficacy track ever score same/contra, is it untested by construction, or should the cell be blank?

Decision 16 with no stated effective exposure: the monkey NOAEL margin held and patients were dosed to clinical effect, but no model source ever stated an effective exposure target. Does 'dosed to target' require a stated target, or does the clinically effective dose stand in for it?

magnitude 'opposite' is defined (decision 5) for a predicted harm that never appeared. When the model predicted the absence of a harm (JAK2-axis sparing) and the harm appeared, is that 'opposite', 'direction_only', or null?

Does an expectation sentence in a model paper's abstract ('a JAK1-selective inhibitor would be expected to ... avoid inhibition of the JAK2 homodimer') count as the model's stated safety prediction, given #111 sets aside mechanism-attribution sentences that name no species or study?
